title: ClassConsolidatorCrossClassLLMOutput
description: LLM output schema for the ClassConsolidator cross-class pass: same-label members extracted as different classes, split into entities with one class each

groups.description: List of groups, each one entity

indices.description: Index list of members that refer to the same thing (0-indexed)

class_name.description: Class the group belongs to; the allowed names are set per call from the classes in the group
